each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json,collections
from collections import deque as dq
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def analyze(name):
    I=G[name+' input'];O=G[name+' output']
    h=len(I);w=len(I[0])
    sr=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(I[i]))==1]; sc=[j for j in range(w) if len({I[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    scol=I[sr[0]][0]
    C=collections.Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    others=[c for c in C if c!=scol]
    bg=max(others,key=lambda c:C[c]); acc=[c for c in others if c!=bg][0]
    print(name,'scol',scol,'bg',bg,'acc',acc,'bands',sr,'cols',sc)
    for r0,r1 in zip([-1]+sr,sr+[h]):
        for c0,c1 in zip([-1]+sc,sc+[w]):
            sub=[I[i][j] for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1)]
            cc=collections.Counter(sub)[acc]
            ch=sum(1 for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1) if I[i][j]!=O[i][j])
            mark='FILLED' if ch and all(O[i][j]==acc for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1)) else 'keep'
            print((r0,r1-1,c0,c1-1),'accn',cc,'changed' if ch else '',mark)
analyze('Demo pair 1'); analyze('Demo pair 2')

def analyze(n):
    g=G[n+' input']; t=G[n+' output']
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    sr=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1]; sc=[j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]

    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in zip([-1]+sr,sr+[h]):
        row=[]
        for c0,c1 in zip([-1]+sc,sc+[w]):
            inn=[(i,j) for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1)]
            a=[(i,j) for i,j in inn if g[i][j]==acc]
            rem=set(a); comps=[]
            while rem:
                seed=next(iter(rem)); rem.discard(seed); st=[seed]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    i,j=st.pop(); comp.append((i,j))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=i+da,j+db
                        if (x,y) in rem: rem.discard((x,y)); st.append((x,y))
                comps.append(comp)
            big=max(comps,key=len)
            rs={i for i,_ in big}; cs={j for _,j in big}
            H=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; W=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
            touches_T=min(i-r0 for i,_ in big)==0
            touches_B=max(i for i,_ in big)==r1-1

            row.append((len(big),H,W,touches_T,touches_B,touches_L,touches_R,'WIN' if ins else ''))
        out.append(row)
    return out

import os,re,collections,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    sr=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1]
    sc=[j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    scol=g[sr[0]][0]
    cs=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r); others=[c for c in cs if c!=scol]
    bg=max(others,key=lambda c:cs[c]); acc=[c for c in others if c!=bg][0]
    bands=[]
    for r0,r1 in zip([-1]+sr,sr+[h]):
        for c0,c1 in zip([-1]+sc,sc+[w]):
            cells=[(i,j) for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1) if g[i][j]==acc]
            if not cells: continue
            bands.append((len(cells),r0+1,r1-1,c0+1,c1-1,cells))
    if not bands: return [r[:] for r in g]
    # winner: max accent count; tie-break largest span
    bands.sort(key=lambda b:(b[0], b[4]-b[2]+1, b[5]-b[3]+1), reverse=True)
    _,r0,r1,c0,c1,_=bands[0]
    out=[[g[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            if g[i][j]!=scol: out[i][j]=acc
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==acc and not (r0<=i<=r1 and c0<=j<=c1): out[i][j]=bg
    return out
